main_body: prehistoric thatched hut with wooden walls
top_band: yellow-brown layered thatched roof slope from row 5 to row 55
evidence: A large sloped thatched roof (rows 5-55) sits above a vertical wooden log wall (rows 56-78). There is a distinct eave overhang casting a shadow at rows 56-57, and the central doorway (rows 53-77) shows an inset inner frame and recessed interior.

style.evidence: The thatched roof features rich tiered straw texture with 6+ value steps from pale yellow highlights on the left down to dark brown eaves. The wooden wall logs and stone foundation have individual plank/stone shading and dark brown/grey material outlines, matching the density and craft of the Beodeul house references.
